strategyReview: The weekend HL funding-reversion live book remains the core positive: 381/551 live wins, +0.13% avg per trade, with shadows at 188/253 and +0.99% avg, so this family is still working in both live and blocked-shadow evidence. One-touch NO is strong only when gated (clean live 4/4, +18.42%; FIND-0020 gated shadows 107/175, +0.89%) and manual IV-touch rich NO / gold XAU tail NO shadows remain promising. The main failures are: broad/ungated one-touch NO and proxy-short variants, several single-threshold shadow-mined funding reversion families, contract-edge theses scored as spot-direction bets, and HYPE-confirmed BTC momentum continuation trades.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS shadow-mined funding reversion is 14/30 (47%), AAPL 12/24 (50%), and MU 7/19 (37%). The losing tests show funding staying pinned or re-tightening: CBRS -4.3% → -33.8%, -6.2% → -33.6%; MU 5.5% → -28.6%. A one-shot funding < -10% does not reliably mean reversion is starting.
failureClusters.recommendation: Replace absolute single-reading triggers with relative lower-tail conditions plus a confirmed positive 24h funding change before entering.

failureClusters.theme: Contract-edge signals graded on spot direction
failureClusters.evidence: H-534 / gold one-touch cap-edge has only 8/23 scorable tests and 7 unscorable because the prediction demanded a >2% gold spot decline while the actual wins came from contract resolution or premium decay. Recent broad one-touch NO shadows also lost repeatedly in OIL/ETH while the gated contract-premium version stayed profitable.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author edge signals as contract P&L theses (sell YES / buy NO premium decay) and never attach a spot-move threshold to a contract-pricing trigger.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 (36%) and btc_iv_compression_vol_reversion is 3/14 (21%). BTC/HYPE above SMA near highs frequently failed to deliver >2% continuation; losses cluster in the 1.2-1.6% move range. HYPE strength is coincident/lagging, not independent leading confirmation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not use HYPE spot-above-SMA alone as BTC continuation confirmation. Require actual HYPE OI expansion and already-positive BTC 24h momentum if the thesis is continued upside.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: replace the single absolute CBRS funding reading below -10% with a relative lower-tail condition plus a normalization confirmation. The failed variant entered on one-shot readings that often stayed pinned negative or re-tightened; waiting for a positive 24h change from a bottom-quartile reading only enters when reversion is already underway.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS perp spot rises >2% within 2 days as deeply negative funding begins normalizing from a relative extreme.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: use a relative lower-tail AAPL funding condition plus a confirmed upward 24h change. The original absolute < -10% condition was too late and too weak, producing many entries when funding was already mild/positive or still rolling over.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL perp spot rises >2% within 2 days as funding normalizes from a relative extreme.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: use a relative lower-tail MU funding condition plus a confirmed upward 24h change. The original single < -10% trigger admitted noisy readings and historical backfill artifacts that did not normalize fast enough.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU perp spot rises >2% within 2 days as funding normalizes from a relative extreme.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: re-author the gold one-touch cap-edge signal as a contract premium fade, not a spot-decline call. Keep the cap-edge trigger but require above-strike, liquid, tight-spread contracts so the P&L is measured on the NO/YES premium, where the observed wins actually occurred.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / buying NO on above-strike GOLD one-touch contracts with a max underlying-cap edge of at least 3 points is profitable over 7 days via contract premium decay.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: drop the weak HYPE-confirmation mechanism and require actual HYPE open-interest expansion plus already-positive BTC 24h momentum. The failed variant treated HYPE above its 24h SMA with OI change > -2% as independent confirmation; it was mostly a lagging risk-on echo.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot rises >2% within 3 days when BTC is above its 24h SMA, within 4% of its 7d high, already up >1.5% over 24h, and HYPE confirms via expanding open interest.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 14/30 scorable tests (47%). Losses show CBRS funding moving from -4.3% to -33.8% and from -6.2% to -33.6%, so a single CBRS funding reading below -10% does not reliably start normalization.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 12/24 scorable tests (50%). Many losses occurred when funding was already mild or positive and failed to rise further, e.g. 5.5% → 5.5% and 2.7% → -3.2%.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 7/19 scorable tests (37%). The only clear wins came after extreme negative readings such as -317.1% → 5.5%; ordinary < -10% triggers repeatedly failed, including 5.5% → -28.6%.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 8/23 scorable tests (35%) and 7 unscorable. The spot-decline criterion is mismatched with the contract P&L; observed wins were contract premium/resolution events such as NO on GOLD below 4300/4200 resolving terminal, not >2% spot declines.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 36% win rate across the cross-asset IV compression family. BTC repeatedly failed to reach +2% despite BTC and HYPE being above their 24h SMAs near 7d highs, indicating HYPE participation was not an independent leading signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO or overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 3/14 scorable tests (21%). Several failures produced only 1.22-1.24% absolute BTC moves after PM IV z-score fell below -1.5, so this compression threshold did not separate genuine vol snapbacks from low-vol drift.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC PM IV below its 30-day mean by more than 1.5 standard deviations reliably leads to a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

journalEntry: The recurring failure across struggling setups is bad instrument framing or too-weak triggers. Gold one-touch NO wins are contract premium wins, not spot-decline wins, so H-534-class signals must be scored on the contract and should not demand a spot move. The shadow-mined funding families fail because a single < -10% reading is noise; refinements now require a relative lower-tail reading and a positive 24h normalization confirmation. The cross-asset BTC momentum family fails because HYPE above SMA is a lagging risk echo, not an independent signal; the refinement requires OI expansion and already-positive BTC momentum. No parameter changes are justified tonight: live weekend funding evidence is not yet significant at the clustered weekend level, and the strongest blocked-shadow results are still small in weekend-cluster count.
